meta.name: detecting-beaconing-patterns-with-zeek
meta.description: Performs statistical analysis of Zeek conn.log connection intervals to detect C2 beaconing patterns. Uses the ZAT library to load Zeek logs into Pandas DataFrames, calculates inter-arrival time standard deviation, and flags periodic connections with low jitter. Use when hunting for command-and-control callbacks in network data.

howto.what: 分析 Zeek 网络日志中的连接时间间隔，找出规律性、低抖动的通信模式，这些模式可能表示被控主机与命令控制服务器之间的信标行为。
howto.when: 当用户提供 Zeek conn.log 文件并请求检测 C2 信标时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 conn.log 文件，找出可能的 C2 信标。
say.note: 技能会加载日志并计算统计指标。

say.text: 帮我检测网络日志中的周期性连接模式。
say.note: 技能会按源/目标 IP 分组并计算标准差。

howto.what_en: Analyzes Zeek conn.log connection intervals to detect periodic, low-jitter patterns indicative of C2 beaconing. Uses ZAT library to load logs into Pandas DataFrames, groups by source/destination pairs, and flags connections with low coefficient of variation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a Zeek conn.log file and requests C2 beacon detection.

say_en.text: Analyze this conn.log for potential C2 beacons.
say_en.note: The skill loads the log and computes statistics.

say_en.text: Detect periodic connection patterns in the network log.
say_en.note: The skill groups by src/dst IP and calculates standard deviation.
